task_description: Implement automatic image capture workflow: two-stage pipeline with continuous live monitoring (stage 1) and automatic high-confidence image capture followed by detailed crack analysis on the captured image (stage 2). Includes configurable threshold, cooldown, status flow, capture history, and fixed analysis display.

verification.summary: All Python modules import cleanly. Flask endpoint tests pass for all new capture endpoints and all existing endpoints remain unchanged. CaptureManager state machine validation passes. Frontend files parse without errors. .gitignore updated.
